_comment: Per-action corrections, keyed by action id (the card id plus its A/B slot, which is exactly how the publisher's sheets label them). Source for every entry below is the publisher's championship-legal English parts lists (v1.02). Those come from the game company, so they outrank both the community database that generated cards.json and an older card scan. Ranges of 0 on a Firing or Projectile action are the community data simply not recording a range at all.

_notes.547_A: H2-B "Crisis" II, Full-auto. A Firing action recorded with no range; the list gives 8.
_notes.550_A: Ls197R Autocannon (L), Single Shot. Firing with no range; the list gives 6.
_notes.551_A: Ls197R Autocannon (R), Single Shot. Same card mirrored, same correction.
_notes.019_B: RT-15C "Glacier" Assault Core, Smoke Grenade. A thrown Projectile with no range; the list gives 2.
_notes.173_B: P7-A3 "Centurion" Node Core, Fire Control Planning. Passive with no range; the list gives 6. Passives do carry ranges in our data already, so 0 here was missing data rather than 'not applicable'.
_notes.509_A: Type 55 Shield + PC-9K Shotgun (R) (D), Shield Bash. We had 1; the list prints Melee, which is range 0. Everything else on the action matches.
_notes.181_B: PLK400 "Centaur" High-mobility Chassis, Sprint. We had a Medium action; the list says Small, which fits a high-mobility chassis.
_notes.182_B: PL35 Armored Chassis, Kick. We had Medium; the list says Small.
_notes.045_B: Type 79 Combat Shield, Barricade. We had the generic Tactic timing; the list says Swift.
_notes.PDAM-001_A: FGM25 "Piranha" Missile, Guided Attack. Tactic in our data, Delayed on the list. Our vocabulary spells that timing 'Delay'.
_notes.PDAM-002_A: FGM46 "Exocet" Missile, Guided Attack. Same correction.
_notes.PDAM-005_A: FG33 "Sardina" Cluster Grenade, Detonation. Tactic in our data, Immediate on the list.
